title: book.json
description: Everything printed around your pages, the running order, and what a store needs to list the book. Point at this file from a book with "$schema": "../../engine/book.schema.json" and your editor will complete and check it as you type.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for your editor. The engine ignores it.

title.description: The book's title, as printed on the cover.

subtitle.description: One line under the title on the cover and the copyright page.

author.description: Printed on the cover, and the creator in the EPUB.

series.description: The label in every page's eyebrow. Defaults to the title.

brand.description: The left of every page's running foot. Usually your site.

editionLabel.description: Printed on the copyright page, and the start of a release folder's name. Example: Edition 1.0

unit.description: What you call a page, plural, in printed copy. Default: blocks.

unitSingular.description: The singular of unit, if dropping the s is not enough.

interior.description: The file holding your pages, if it is not <slug>.html. A file name, not a path.

numbered.description: Print No. 01, No. 02 in the eyebrow. Default: true.

contents.description: Generate a contents page. Default: true.

index.description: Generate an alphabetical index. Default: true.

accentStrong.description: The darker accent, for small caps labels.

kicker.description: Small caps line above the title.

note.description: A line at the foot of the cover.

rights.description: The rights line. Default: (c) <year> <author>. All rights reserved.

lines.description: Extra lines on the copyright page, above the rights line. Put your ISBN here: it is not printed for you.

parts.description: The running order. Every part gets a divider page.

eyebrow.description: Small caps line on the divider.

why.description: One line telling the reader why these pages belong together.

listLabel.description: Heading over the divider's page list. Default: In this part.

blocks.description: Page titles, in reading order, exactly as in each page's <h1 class="title">.

editions.description: The same pages cut into different books. Each edition is the list of page titles it keeps.

matter.description: The pages around your pages. front: a dedication and an epigraph go before the contents, everything else after it. back: before the index. Build with engine/tools/build.mjs.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag: en, en-GB, ar, fr-CA. Goes into the EPUB and tells a store what it is selling.

identifier.description: The EPUB's unique id, as a URN. Only needed if you have no EPUB ISBN and want your own id; otherwise one is derived from the book's folder and stays stable.

publishing.description: What a store listing asks for. None of it is printed in the book. It goes into the EPUB's metadata and into listing.md in every release.

description.description: The blurb. Stores cap it at 4000 characters.

categories.description: BISAC codes or the store's own category paths. Example: COM053000 or Computers / Security / General

publisher.description: The imprint. Defaults to brand in the EPUB.

audience.description: Who it is for, in a few words. For you and for the listing sheet.

editions.description: Anything that differs for one edition. Keys are edition names from "editions".

title.description: Listing title for this edition, if it is not "<title> (<edition> edition)".

kind.description: dedication: a few centred lines. epigraph: a quotation. prose: a heading and paragraphs (preface, introduction, about the author). list: a heading and named items (also by, further reading). sources: generated from FACTS.md, nothing to write.

title.description: The heading, and the line in the contents. Needed for prose and list. Sources defaults to Sources.

body.description: One string per paragraph (per line, for a dedication). **bold** and *italic* work. A paragraph starting with '## ' is a subheading. Long prose continues onto another sheet by itself.

by.description: Who said the epigraph, or the name a preface is signed with.

toc.description: List it in the contents. Default: true, except a dedication and an epigraph.

editions.description: Only in these editions. full is the whole book. Leave out for every edition.

isbn.description: ISBN-13, hyphens optional. The check digit is verified by preflight.

isbns.description: One ISBN per format. A print book and its ebook may not share one.
